extras: Desktop only (Windows/macOS/Linux). Mobile is not supported. The 'New writing mode' is experimental and has significant limitations.
intentEvidence: Tategaki is a desktop-first Obsidian plugin that lets you edit and view Markdown in a vertical (tategaki) layout.
problem: Standard horizontal writing layouts do not support vertical writing styles, making it difficult to read or write in those formats within Obsidian.
summary: Tategaki allows users to edit and view Markdown content in a vertical (tategaki) layout, supporting both writing and reading modes.
